### 💡 Codex Review https://github.com/jonathanong/no-mistakes/blob/403b43c38d9e687598a58465aa444b261ffbb5d8/crates/no-mistakes/src/codebase/postgres/embedded/walk/variants/switch/labels.rs#L44-L45 **![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat) Skip generator bodies when resolving call/apply** When the receiver is a generator function expression, `.call()` or `.apply()` only creates an iterator and does not execute the function body. Traversing it here nevertheless treats assignments inside that suspended body as switch-label writes, so a later guard-dependent SQL call becomes unnecessarily opaque, producing a spurious `unanalyzable` finding or hiding the finite SQL check when `unanalyzableSql: ignore` is configured. Check `function.generator` before walking the body and add a fixture-backed regression for this invocation form.
